title: Meeting Cost & ROI Calculator
method: Read-only public page reads + web search of Gumroad listing pages and public guides. Prices taken from each page's own displayed price. No purchase, no account, $0.

competitors.name: Meeting Cost Calculator Spreadsheet - Time, Headcount & Burn (Kosmic Rift)
competitors.notes: Most comparable paid product. Sheets: Setup (default hourly rate, work-week hours, currency), Meeting Log (attendees, duration, rate override, auto cost), Recurring Burn (weekly -> monthly/annualized), Dashboard KPIs (total logged, this month, top expensive meeting, recurring burn). .xlsx, formulas only, sample rows labeled SAMPLE.
competitors.verified_by: Claude (web search of the live product page + its checkout page showing US$12)

competitors.name: Meeting Cost Calculator (Standard Work Co.)
competitors.notes: FREE / name-your-price substitute. A single offline HTML file that costs a recurring meeting by attendee salary, duration and frequency, then divides by decisions produced (cost per decision). Direct competitor to the core idea, at $0.
competitors.verified_by: Claude (web search of the live product page showing '$0+')

competitors.name: Effective Meetings Cost Calculator (QUICKFix)
competitors.notes: Excel spreadsheet computing annual meeting cost, annual productivity cost, and total annual cost.
competitors.verified_by: Claude (web search of the live vendor page showing $5.77)

competitors.name: Meeting Cost Calculator Template (Calcam)
competitors.notes: Template outputs: annual cost of a meeting, cost per meeting, weekly cost, person-hours/year. Part of a paid tool with plans; exact one-off price not exposed on the page read.
competitors.verified_by: Claude (web search of the live template page)

competitors.name: Meeting Tax - See What Meetings Actually Cost (Clear Stack)
competitors.notes: Paid Gumroad listing, US$9. Offline HTML app: attendees x duration x your rate = real $ cost, person-hours, Must/Should/Cut decision with a one-line reason, weekly rollup. Close format to ours (calculation + a keep/cut decision), simpler than a multi-sheet workbook.
competitors.verified_by: Claude (web search of the live product page showing $9)

competitors.name: Meeting Notes & Action Items - Run Better Meetings (branga breow)
competitors.notes: Paid Gumroad listing, US$2.40. Excel template for meeting log, action items, decisions log and parking lot - adjacent (meeting records, not meeting cost), and the cheapest paid comparable.
competitors.verified_by: Claude (web search of the live product page showing $2.40)

free_substitutes.what: Build-your-own guide with the exact formula and spreadsheet layout
free_substitutes.risk: A motivated buyer can build the calculator from this guide for free

free_substitutes.what: Meeting cost formula + loaded-rate surcharge guidance
free_substitutes.risk: Explains the loaded-rate surcharge (EU ~20%, US ~35%) for free
Instant free cost number (no log, no ranking); covers the single-number use case

not_verified.reason: Gumroad does not expose per-listing sales counts publicly; UNKNOWN

not_verified.item: Number of competing 'meeting cost' listings on Gumroad
not_verified.reason: Gumroad search is client-rendered and not enumerable by a read-only GET; only the individually surfaced listings above were confirmed. UNKNOWN (confirmed lower bound: 3 paid Gumroad listings - Kosmic Rift $12, Meeting Tax $9, Meeting Notes $2.40 - plus the $0+ substitute).

competition_level: MODERATE: 4 real paid comparables confirmed ($12 Kosmic Rift, $9 Meeting Tax, $5.77 QUICKFix, $2.40 Meeting Notes) plus a free/name-your-price Gumroad substitute ($0+) and free guides/calculators. The math is public knowledge; the paid value must be the workflow, ranking and dashboard.

price_recommendation.basis: Most comparable paid product is $12.00 (Kosmic Rift), and a free $0+ Gumroad substitute exists. Consistent with the B12-001 precedent (priced just below the most comparable), $11.99 sits below the $12 comparable while the bundle adds decision-ROI and a kill-review the comparable lacks.
price_recommendation.note: $14.99 (B12-001's price) is also defensible, but the free $0+ substitute makes a sub-$12 price the safer first-listing choice.
